content.summary: Shares of precision motion systems specialist Allient (NASDAQ:ALNT) jumped 5.6% in the afternoon session after Roth Capital maintained its Buy recommendation on the stock. This action suggested that the analyst still saw potential for the stock's price to rise, which likely encouraged buying activity among investors.
